title: Prevention of Pacemaker Lead Induced Tricuspid regurgitAtion by Transesophageal eCho guidEd Implantation (PLACE)
official: Prevention of Pacemaker Lead Induced Tricuspid regurgitAtion by Transesophageal eCho guidEd Implantation (PLACE)
summary: This is the first randomized controlled trial comparing transesophageal echocardiography + fluoroscopy guided lead implantation vs. standard lead implantation guided by fluoroscopy only. Patients are randomized 1:1 in the two groups and followed up for up to 3 years.

interventions.name: Additional guidance of lead implantation by transesophageal echocardiography

criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* indication for right ventricular lead implantation according to current guidelines

Exclusion Criteria:

* preexisting tricuspid regurgitation ≥ grade 2
* other severe heart valve disease
* history of tricuspid valve treatment
* preexisting right ventricular lead
* chronic dialysis
* contraindication for transesophageal echocardiography
